_doc: Reconcile legacy search-only stories against currently collected, approved publisher articles. Unmatched legacy titles may be shown separately as unverified metadata; model analysis and search links are never exposed there. CSV policy/licence exclusions still win. No new source is activated.
_serve_pending_titles_doc: false: a headline without a verified publisher link is never served (every story must link to its article). The waiting list code stays; set true to show them again.
